purpose: Represent and evaluate hard and soft constraints before prediction, ranking, recommendation, or execution preparation.
invariants: company_id is the sole canonical tenant/company boundary.
company_boundary is always hard, critical, non-relaxable, and non-overridable.
Hard constraints cannot be compensated for by soft utility or objective weights.
Unknown hard permission, jurisdiction, policy, safety, privacy, capability, entitlement, or company-boundary constraints fail closed or escalate according to policy.
Constraints describe eligibility and trade-off restrictions; they do not create permission, entitlement, approval, or execution authority.
Caller-supplied legacy tenant identifiers are not authority and must normalize to trusted company_id before evaluation.
Constraint provenance, temporal validity, and authority requirements are retained.
